cli_config_docs_contract.docs/configuration.md:
# Configuration

DM-Code-Agent can be configured with CLI flags or environment variables.

<!-- CONFIG_TABLE -->
| Option | Env | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--model` | `DM_MODEL` | `deepseek-chat` | Model identifier passed to the provider. |
| `--provider` | `DM_PROVIDER` | `deepseek` | LLM provider name. |
| `--retries` | `DM_RETRIES` | `2` | Retry count for transient provider failures. |
| `--timeout` | `DM_TIMEOUT` | `120` | Provider request timeout in seconds. |
<!-- /CONFIG_TABLE -->

packaging_ci_contract.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "demo-agent-plugin"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Small package used by the maintenance benchmark."
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["click>=8.1"]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.4", "black>=24.0"]
packaging_ci_contract..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
      - run: python -m pytest
      - run: python -m ruff check dm_agent tests
      - run: python -m black --check .
